# Parser provenance

This directory contains LibreLog-derived parser components: `grouping.py`,
`llama_parser.py`, and `regex_manager.py`. Workflow input/output and model-client
adaptations live outside this directory. Existing source attribution is preserved.
An embedded private IPv4 example in `llama_parser.py` has been replaced with a
documentation-range address. This public copy is therefore not byte-identical
to the supplied parser snapshot; no parser algorithm was changed by that edit.

The project maintainers have confirmed permission to redistribute these components.
See the root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for attribution. Private filesystem paths
are not part of the public provenance record.
